evals.name: auth-header
evals.prompt: Every endpoint of our API (base `ApiEndpoint extends RestEndpoint` in src/resources/ApiEndpoint.ts) must send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` using `await getToken()` from src/lib/auth.ts. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Overrides getHeaders (or getRequestInit) on the base endpoint; does not override fetch.
assertions: Adds the header by overriding `getHeaders` or `getRequestInit`.

evals.name: shared-polling
evals.prompt: The dashboard shows `useLive(getTicker, { product_id })` with `pollFrequency: 5000`. The detail page needs the same product every 500ms. Add `getTickerFast = getTicker.extend({ pollFrequency: 500 })` for it; the dashboard should keep polling every 5s.
evals.expected_output: Explains that subscribers to the same args share one poll at the fastest frequency, so the dashboard would also poll at 500ms while the detail page is mounted.
assertions: States that both views share one poll at the fastest frequency, so the dashboard speeds up too.
Does not claim the extended endpoint polls independently.

evals.name: parent-count-after-child-mutation
evals.prompt: `Discussion` (an Entity from `DiscussionResource = resource({ path: '/discussions/:id', ... })`) now has a server-computed `commentCount`, shown in the discussions table and on the discussion page. Comments are created with `ctrl.fetch(createComment, { discussionId }, body)` and deleted with `ctrl.fetch(deleteComment, { id })`; their responses contain only the comment and we can't change the API. Keep both counts correct after a comment is created or deleted.
evals.expected_output: After each comment mutation resolves, fetches the parent: `ctrl.fetch(DiscussionResource.get, { id: discussionId })`. Explains that normalization updates the table row too.
assertions: After the comment mutation resolves, fetches the discussion's single-item endpoint (or expires the discussion endpoints when there is none).
Does not pass the count or an onCountChange-style callback between components.
Does not call invalidateAll, resetEntireStore, or refetch the discussions list.
Does not add the discussion to the comment endpoint's optimistic response.

evals.name: parent-count-bundled-response
evals.prompt: We own the API. Creating a comment (`POST /posts/:postId/comments`) should update the post's `commentCount` (on the `Post` Entity) everywhere it shows, with no extra request. Change the endpoint definitions and the server response shape as needed.
evals.expected_output: The create (and delete) response returns `{ comment, post }`, and the endpoint schemas become `{ comment: <push or Invalidate schema>, post: Post }`.
assertions: The mutation response includes the updated post and the endpoint schema adds `post: Post`.
Does not refetch the post or call expireAll/invalidateAll after the mutation.

evals.name: parent-resource-behind-import-boundary
evals.prompt: After a comment is created or deleted, the discussion page's "N comments" (from the server-computed `Discussion.commentCount`) must update. Comment mutations run in `src/features/comments/components/` with `ctrl.fetch(createComment, { discussionId }, body)` and `ctrl.fetch(deleteComment, { id })`; their responses contain only the comment and we can't change the API. `Discussion` and `DiscussionResource` are in `src/features/discussions/api/discussion.ts`. ESLint's `import/no-restricted-paths` forbids `src/features/comments` from importing `src/features/discussions`; every feature may import `src/lib`.
evals.expected_output: Moves `Discussion` and `DiscussionResource` into a shared folder under `src/lib` (e.g. `src/lib/resources/discussion.ts`), updates their imports, and fetches `DiscussionResource.get` with the comment's `discussionId` after each comment mutation, inside the comments feature.
assertions: Moves `Discussion` and `DiscussionResource` out of `src/features/discussions` into a folder under `src/lib` (or another folder every feature may import) and updates the existing imports.
The comments feature fetches the discussion (`DiscussionResource.get`) after the mutation resolves.
Does not pass a callback or the count through components or routes.
Does not disable, loosen or eslint-disable the `import/no-restricted-paths` rule, and does not copy the Entity.
